scope: Adaptive display collection: repeat known successful held-out validation initializations and vary inference RNG. NOT independent formal evaluation or full fruit classification. Each video is one actual run, never copied as a new trial.
stopping_rule: Stop once 40 eligible decoded videos exist and every class has>=8 successes with>=4 real failures; exact RNG0 repetitions skipped for a class once quota is met. All trials retained and reported separately from display.
failure_policy: Every model/physics/infra failure retained; no hidden resets during execution, no changed target/shape/friction/score; test partition untouched.
